fees.label: Certificate of Occupancy - Sale inspection
fees.quote: Return this completed application along with the $50.00 inspection fee to the Weymouth Township Housing Officer at the below address.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Complete the Application for Certificate of Occupancy (check 'Certificate of Occupancy - Sale'; give block, lot, settlement date, owner and the contact person for the inspection appointment) and return it with the $50.00 inspection fee to the Housing Officer, 45 South Jersey Avenue, Dorothy, NJ 08317. The Housing Officer inspects within 14 days. Separately get the NJ DCA smoke/CO certificate online; the Township will not issue the CO until it receives it.

evidence.quote: Request for ( ) Certificate of Occupancy - Sale ( ) Certificate of Occupancy - Rental
Inspections will be done by the Housing Officer Chase Farabella within in fourteen (14) days of receipt of the completed application and payment.

NOTICE: A Certificate of Occupancy will not be issued until Weymouth Township receives a valid New Jersey Division of Community Affairs (DCA), Division of Fire Safety (DFS) Certificate of Fire Inspection of Smoke Detector, Carbon Monoxide Alarm and Portable Fire Extinguisher Compliance
The CSDCMAC is in addition to the Housing Officer's Certificates of Occupancy or Rental Certificate of Habitability inspection.
Chase Farabella, Housing Officer Address: 45 South Jersey Avenue Dorothy, NJ 08317 Housing Office: 609-476-2633 Extension # 3

resale_co.notes: Weymouth's Housing Office runs a Certificate of Occupancy inspection for sales and rentals under the Township's Certificate of Occupancy Code (Chapter 106, on ecode360, which could not be opened). The August 2026 application and the Housing Officer's information sheet say the state smoke/CO certificate is needed in addition to the Township CO when title transfers. The form does not list the inspection checklist or a reinspection fee. Rental registration and rental insurance are separate programs.

requirements: State online self-certification, now named the Certificate of Smoke Alarm, Carbon Monoxide Alarm, and Secondary Power Source Identification Label Compliance (CSACMASPSIL): smoke alarms, carbon monoxide alarms, and the secondary power source label for homes with solar, generators or batteries. The certificate name no longer includes the fire extinguisher, although the portal's checklist notice still refers to detectors and fire extinguishers

The Township's information sheet (revised 08/26/26) still describes the extinguisher rule: minimum 2A:10B:C, no more than 10 pounds, within 10 feet of the kitchen stove in the exit path, top no more than 5 feet above the floor on the manufacturer's bracket, serviced and tagged by a DFS-certified contractor within 12 months or a recent purchase receipt

authorities.name: NJ DCA Division of Fire Safety, Bureau of Fire Code Enforcement
authorities.lead_time: More than 10 business days before closing for the lowest fee

fees.label: More than 10 business days before closing
fees.quote: If you are applying for a certificate more than ten business days from the closing date the fee is $45 dollars

fees.label: 4 to 10 business days before closing
fees.quote: if applying 4 to 10 business days from the closing date the fee is $90

fees.label: Less than 4 business days before closing
fees.quote: if the closing date is less than four business days the fee is $161.

authorities.how_to_apply: Apply online through the NJ DCA Fire Safety portal ('Start Your Smoke Certification Application'). Pay by e-check or credit card before submitting; a valid email address is required. The certificate is emailed once the application is submitted, the fee is paid and any required inspections are done. Homes heated by electricity with no CO alarm requirement should also email BFCE_CSDCMAC@dca.nj.gov.
authorities.contact_title: Bureau Chief, Bureau of Fire Code Enforcement (listed as the Fire Official in the state fire directory)

evidence.quote: The application for the Smoke Detector and Carbon Monoxide Alarm and Fire Extinguisher Compliance Certificate is obtained on line at https://firesolutions.dca.nj.gov/

NJ DCA DFS requires all rentals must have a SMOKE DETECTOR AND CARBON MONOXIDE ALARM AND FIRE EXTINGUISHER COMPLIANCE CERTIFICATE issued by the NJ DCA DFS every time there is a change in tenants or if the property is sold.
LEAID: 0123-999 Enf Auth. State Fire Official Louis Kilmer Phone (609)633-6132 Addr: PO Box 809

Please complete the following information to apply for a Certificate of Smoke Alarm, Carbon Monoxide Alarm, and Secondary Power Source Identification Label Compliance (CSACMASPSIL). You will be required to pay, via e-check or credit card, before you can submit this application. This application requires a valid email address.

if your property is heated with electricity and does not require a carbon monoxide alarm, check the fourth box and send an email to BFCE_CSDCMAC@dca.nj.gov stating that you are not subject to that requirement.
Louis Kilmer, Bureau Chief CPM Address: P.O. Box 809, Trenton, NJ 08625-0809 Phone: (609) 633-6106

fire_cert.notes: NJ DCA lists Weymouth as State enforced (S) and its July 17, 2026 list marks it 'SC' (the State issues smoke certificates). The Township's own CO application and Housing Officer information sheet (both revised 8/26/26) send applicants to the DCA online portal, and the Township will not issue its CO until it receives the DCA certificate. The directory gives (609) 633-6132 for Louis Kilmer (also printed on the Township sheet for DCA); the Bureau's own page gives (609) 633-6106, which is used here.

other_items.label: NJ DCA smoke/CO certificate before the Township CO
other_items.detail: The Township CO is not issued until the Township receives the DCA smoke/CO certificate.
